use_rule: May use ONLY the listed canon ids, and from C-beat-1 and C-beat-2 only: waking in a ruin, falling ash, cold, alone, remembering nothing, scavenging, flint and a first fire. Everything else in canon is out of bounds, including anything else in those two facts.
deliverable: content/team/drafts/T1-<lens>.md: the lines, then one line per line naming the canon id it draws on.
must_not: any proper noun except the Hollow
the book, its torn pages, margins or handwriting
the stool or anything wobbling
a wrist, scar or mark
warm ground, seams, red glow, the camp stone
magic, ash on hands, the burn, the Chequer, keels, holders, the Essart, the Breaking, faith
another person, wolves, any creature
any hint of having been here before, of 'again', of a past self
a stated moral or an explained turn
